claims.sentence: Third quarter revenue was $665 million, as enrollment pressure in the KinderCare brand was partially offset by continued growth in Champions, which delivered its fifth consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.

claims.speaker: Tony Amandi
claims.sentence: Third quarter revenue was $665 million, a decline of 1.7% from $677 million last year.

claims.speaker: Tony Amandi
claims.sentence: These decreases were partially offset by approximately $13 million in revenue from newer and acquired centers entering the same-center cohort.

claims.speaker: Tony Amandi
claims.sentence: Turning to other components of our revenue performance, Champions contributed approximately $8 million in year-over-year revenue growth.

claims.speaker: Tony Amandi
claims.sentence: New and acquired centers have contributed approximately $20 million in revenue so far this year.

claims.speaker: Tony Amandi
claims.sentence: Turning to the financial impact of our footprint optimization, we estimate that center closures will result in revenue headwind of approximately $32 million for 2026.

claims.speaker: Tony Amandi
claims.sentence: Turning to profitability, we reported a net loss of $85 million, or $0.71 per share, compared to net income of $5 million, or $0.04 per share, in the prior year quarter.
